meta.title: Siaya County development project register
meta.scope: Projects named in the CIDP 2023-2027 capital and flagship tables, the county budget implementation reports for FY 2025/26 (Q1 to Q4), the Controller of Budget annual reports (Siaya tables for FY 2018/19 and FY 2020/21 to 2024/25), the Auditor-General reports in data/siaya-audits.json, and the CADP 2025/26 public participation report. Not exhaustive: these tables list only the highest-spending and stalled projects.
status_rules: planned: in a plan (CIDP) with no later evidence.
tendered / contracted: tender or contract evidence only, no works evidence (none in this release).
active: works or payments under way and not past the expected completion date in the evidence.
delayed: incomplete after the expected completion date, from the audit or from the county's own dates.
suspended: listed as stalled by the county, or works found stopped or abandoned by the auditor.
completed-reported: the county (directly, in a CoB table, or as quoted by the auditor) reports completion or 100%.
completed-independently-verified: the Auditor-General (or another independent party) states on inspection that the works were complete.
cancelled: contract terminated or budget removed.
unknown: only spending, or conflicting or incomplete evidence.
Where sources disagree, the status follows the latest evidence; independent evidence outranks a county report of the same or earlier date. The disagreement is kept in conflicts.

evidence_types.audit_physical_verification: independent: Auditor-General site inspection or physical verification
evidence_types.audit_documentary_review: independent: Auditor-General review of records or interviews
evidence_types.cob_report_county_data: county data in a Controller of Budget report ("Source: Siaya County Treasury")

meta.amount_rule: Amounts are as printed, in the unit given (KSh, or KSh million for the CIDP). fy is the financial year of the document that prints the figure. No figure is summed, converted or inflated. A printed paid amount above a contract sum is kept as printed and noted.
meta.page_rule: page is the 1-based PDF page, not the printed page number.
meta.names_rule: No individuals are named. Contractors are named only where an official report prints a company name; most reports describe the contractor only as "a firm" and no name is given. Road and facility names are kept as printed.
meta.location_rule: Each printed location is resolved against data/siaya-geography.json (ward or constituency names and aliases) or listed as unresolved with a reason. Towns, facilities and "Executive" are not resolved to a ward.
